title: Boltz-2 Input Parameters
description: Boltz-2 is used as a structure predictor / binder validator. The request carries a target sequence plus one or more binder sequences to co-fold; the target PDB, if supplied, is used as a structural template.

targetPdb.description: Optional path to the target PDB, used as a templating hint for the target chain.

targetSeq.description: Amino-acid sequence of the target chain (chain A in the emitted YAML config).

binders.description: One or more binder sequences to co-fold with the target. Each produces a separate prediction.

params.description: Boltz-2 sampler knobs; mapped directly to the upstream CLI.

recycling_steps.description: Number of recycling iterations through the trunk.

diffusion_samples.description: Number of diffusion samples drawn per binder (best is kept).
